rationale: GEO series bundles a 607 MB RAW.tar across 8 GSM samples, and per-GSM pages confirm at least GSM7058754 (immune) and GSM7058755 (non-immune) are publicly downloadable processed count matrices (raw UMI counts, per GEO's own field name) + per-cell metadata -- GEO's own record states raw sequencing data is not provided here, only processed data, so publicly accessible processed count/meta files are available without an access request for those two files. See DATA/registry/GSE225857/source_manifest.tsv for the full reviewed terms on both routes.
